# Behavior review decision record (optional)

A normal PR review can record these decisions instead. CI already records execution evidence; do not manually duplicate its logs.

- Reviewer / component owner:
- PR and checked commit:
- Actions run and artifact:
- Component / profile:
- Expectation and adapter: accepted / changes requested / undecided
- Rule or scope concerns:
- Finding: request fix / revise rule / reject / no finding / incomplete
- Test: keep / revise / reject / not applicable
- Reasons for the decisions:
- Retained test commit and subsequent CI result:
- What existing tests already explained:
- Specific additional failure or clearer reproduction:
- Observed review effort, if measured (not automation runtime):
- Explanation needed from the author, if any:
- Independently selected case/control and relation to strategy freeze, if applicable:
- Misses, execution problems, exclusions and limitations:
- Next action and responsible implementation agent/owner:

Generated results do not record owner approval. Authored calibration does not establish independent detection accuracy or human time saved.
